require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'json'
require 'resolv'
require 'ipaddr'

module WebhookService
  PRIVATE_RANGES = [
    IPAddr.new('10.0.0.0/8'),
    IPAddr.new('172.16.0.0/12'),
    IPAddr.new('192.168.0.0/16'),
    IPAddr.new('127.0.0.0/8'),
    IPAddr.new('169.254.0.0/16'),
    IPAddr.new('::1/128'),
    IPAddr.new('fc00::/7')
  ].freeze

  MAX_RETRIES = 3
  RETRY_DELAY_BASE = 0.5
  RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 60
  RATE_LIMIT_MAX = 10

  class RateLimiter
    def initialize
      @requests = {}
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end

    def allow?(domain)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        now = Time.now.to_f
        @requests[domain] ||= []
        @requests[domain].reject! { |t| now - t > RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW }
        if @requests[domain].size < RATE_LIMIT_MAX
          @requests[domain] << now
          true
        else
          false
        end
      end
    end
  end

  class AddressValidator
    def self.resolve_and_validate(hostname)
      addresses = Resolv::DNS.new.getaddresses(hostname)
      raise "DNS resolution failed for #{hostname}" if addresses.empty?

      addresses.each do |addr|
        ip = IPAddr.new(addr.to_s)
        if PRIVATE_RANGES.any? { |range| range.include?(ip) }
          raise "Resolved to private IP: #{addr}"
        end
      end

      addresses.first.to_s
    end
  end

  class WebhookDispatcher
    def initialize
      @rate_limiter = RateLimiter.new
      @delivery_cache = {}
    end

    def deliver(url, payload, idempotency_key: nil)
      uri = URI.parse(url)
      raise "Invalid scheme: #{uri.scheme}" unless %w[http https].include?(uri.scheme)
      raise "Missing host" unless uri.host

      domain = uri.host.downcase
      raise "Rate limited" unless @rate_limiter.allow?(domain)

      if idempotency_key && @delivery_cache[idempotency_key]
        return @delivery_cache[idempotency_key]
      end

      validated_ip = AddressValidator.resolve_and_validate(domain)

      response = execute_with_retry(uri, payload, validated_ip)

      result = { status: response.code.to_i, body: response.body }
      @delivery_cache[idempotency_key] = result if idempotency_key
      result
    end

    private

    def execute_with_retry(uri, payload, validated_ip)
      retries = 0
      begin
        perform_request(uri, payload, validated_ip)
      rescue Net::OpenTimeout, Net::ReadTimeout, Errno::ECONNREFUSED => e
        retries += 1
        if retries <= MAX_RETRIES
          sleep(RETRY_DELAY_BASE * (2 ** retries))
          re_validated_ip = AddressValidator.resolve_and_validate(uri.host)
          validated_ip = re_validated_ip
          retry
        end
        raise "Delivery failed after #{MAX_RETRIES} retries: #{e.message}"
      end
    end

    def perform_request(uri, payload, pinned_ip)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(pinned_ip, uri.port)
      http.open_timeout = 5
      http.read_timeout = 10
      http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == 'https')
      if http.use_ssl?
        http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
      end

      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.request_uri)
      request['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      request['User-Agent'] = 'WebhookService/1.0'
      request['Host'] = uri.host
      request.body = payload.to_json

      http.request(request)
    end
  end
end
